subject: Clarion Health — post-call technical recap & SLO alignment
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Clarion Health — post-call technical recap & SLO alignment

Hi Priya / Arjun — thanks again for the deep-dive today. Quick recap from our side and the concrete asks we agreed on. I kept this intentionally short so we can align on the pilot scope and timeline.

1) Primary pain & goal (your framing)
- Pain: latency spikes and unpredictable tail latency for clinical summarization & charting workflows (40–70 token system prompts + 400–800 token outputs).
- Goal: reliable interactive experience for clinicians — p95 latency <= 120ms, p99 <= 300ms during sustained hours; sustained throughput target ~50 req/s with burst to 250 req/s for end-of-shift spikes.

2) Model / quality requirements
- Prefer instruction-tuned models similar to 7B family for most prompts; keep a 13B fallback for the 10% of requests requiring higher factual fidelity.
- Tokenization: typical request ~600 tokens; KV cache reuse expected across short sessions.
- Embeddings usage for retrieval + reranking (will want separate embedding endpoints).

3) Topology & deployment preferences discussed
- Primary: Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) in our us-west region for predictable throughput and KMS integration.
- Backup: Hosted with automatic fallback to a quantized 7B variant if Dedicated capacity saturates.
- Requirements: VPC peering, SOC 2 evidence, HSM/KMS for keys, and retention controls for PHI.

4) Ops asks we flagged (SE items)
- Prefix/KV caching TTL suggestion: 30 minutes for session reuse; we recommended caching at the model layer, not only at app-side.
- Batching target: keep batching window <= 10ms to preserve interactive latency.
- Observability: token-level cost and p95/p99 tracing required per route.

5) Next steps & owners
- Clarion: confirm expected sustained QPS (50 req/s) and absolute concurrency (how many simultaneous clinicians?) — action: Priya (Clarion)
- Redwood SE: provide a pilot config (nodes, GPU type, quantization variants) + cost estimate for 30-day pilot — action: Ben (Redwood)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya@clarionhealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarion Health — post-call technical recap & SLO alignment

Priya — quick SE notes and a few clarifying Qs (following Sofia's summary). I put the items we need from you in bold.

- Baseline assumptions I used for the pilot estimate: 50 sustained req/s, average 650 tokens per request (request+response), 30% cache hit rate on early tokens (session reuse). If either of these moves substantially, our sizing changes non-linearly.

- GPU / topology options we recommend for pilot:
  * Option A (latency-first): 2x A10G (private/dedicated) with 1 replica per 25 req/s, KV cache enabled. Good for hitting p95 ~110–130ms depending on prompt length.
  * Option B (cost-balanced): 4x T4 quantized 7B with a 13B fallback on hosted for heavy queries. Lower cost but p99 risk under burst.

- Observability & rollout: we'll instrument route-level p95/p99 and token counts. We can add a lightweight eval harness to monitor hallucination/lookback faults during pilot.

Clarifying questions (please answer where possible):
- **What is your expected absolute concurrency (how many clinicians using the tool at once during peak)?**
- **Do you have an SLA requirement for p99 or only p95?**
- **Will Clarion store PHI in prompts? If so we need explicit retention rules and enumeration of fields that must be redacted.**

I attached a short draft pilot scope and a topology sketch (PDF/PNG). I can turn this into a formal quote once we have the concurrency and PHI answers.

—Ben
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: clarion_poc_scope.pdf, clarion_topology_sketch.png

From: Priya Mehta <priya@clarionhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Rao <arjun@clarionhealth.com>, eng-team@clarionhealth.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarion Health — post-call technical recap & SLO alignment

Thanks Sofia and Ben — useful summary. Answers inline: 

- Concurrency: during peak shift change we expect ~40 simultaneous active clinicians (typing/confirming), with an additional 120 queued/batching-like bursts across the system — so sustained concurrency target ~40, burst concurrency up to ~160.
- p99 requirement: we'd like p95 <= 120ms as primary, but we need p99 to be reasonable (<400ms) for patient-safety flows.
- PHI: yes, notes contain PHI. We will need retention controls and the ability to toggle persistent storage per-route. Clarion IT will share the redaction rubric this week.

We reviewed the topology options with Arjun — leaning toward Option A for the pilot given the latency targets. We can provide a small sample trace dataset (anonymized) for profiling.

Next logistical items:
- Pilot kickoff target: week of Sep 13 (2-week setup + 30-day pilot).
- Decision makers: myself + Arjun (Eng) + Amal (Head of Security). I'll loop Amal in after I send the redaction rubric.

Appreciate the fast turnaround on the pilot config.

—Priya
Head of Product, Clarion Health

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Clarion Health — post-call technical recap & SLO alignment

Great — thanks for the quick clarifications, Priya. Short follow-up to lock the plan: 

1) Pilot scope (agreed): Option A (latency-first) reserved pool + KV cache + KMS for keys; 30-day data retention default but configurable per-route per your rubric. Ben to share formal pilot sizing + cost by Tue Aug 31.
2) Pilot kickoff: tentatively week of Sep 13 — Sofia to send calendar holds for initial kick-off and seeding meeting (30 min).
3) Deliverables before kickoff:
   - Clarion: anonymized sample traces + redaction rubric (Priya)
   - Redwood: pilot configuration + cost estimate + SOC 2 / KMS integration checklist (Ben)

If that matches your expectation I'll convert this thread into a mutual action plan in HubSpot and add owners/dates.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
